verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an open-source bulk-import tool that ingests a JSON/CSV file of users and creates them via the Backend API (respecting rate limits), which is a genuine bulk operation, and its Backend API/OpenAPI spec could support scripted bulk actions. However, there is no evidence of broader bulk operations (batch update, delete, role reassignment, export) or of an AI-agent-oriented bulk workflow beyond this migration use case. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete/export endpoints, evidence of AI-agent-driven bulk workflows beyond migration, and any first-party UI/CLI for bulk management.
